description: FightController tracks its selection in `current_fighter_id`, so the old `active_unit_id`-only scan in Main._selected_unit_id_or_empty() came back empty for the whole fight phase — the same defect that made the datasheet key (I) dead in shooting. Drives the real path: pass both Pile In halves, pick a fighter from the FightSelectionPanel, and assert the selection lookup resolves to that unit (with FightController asked first) so the datasheet key / fit-to-selection / pad-Y all have something to act on. NOTE: selecting a fighter immediately raises AttackAssignmentDialog, and that is an AcceptDialog — probed live at this exact point it reports visible=true exclusive=true has_focus=true, i.e. a focused embedded SUBWINDOW with its own viewport, so keystrokes route there and Main._input never sees them (verified: simulate_key I here leaves the card closed). That is pre-existing fight-phase modal behaviour, not the selection lookup, so this scenario opens the card through the same lookup Main._input uses rather than via simulate_key. Shooting/movement, where no such dialog is in the way, are covered end-to-end by datasheet_key_all_phases / datasheet_key_movement_phase.
